[RAOT.1.2] The AOT path goes further: the compiler generates C code
from the same trees the interpreter would walk, runs it through a C
compiler (`clang` or `gcc`), and embeds the resulting machine code in
`CompiledCode` atoms.  When the runtime loads a `CompiledCode` atom matching its
architecture, it wires the compiled function directly into the Rete
node — no interpretation at rule-fire time.
